note: Delivery is built but not activated. To activate: add a destination with consentAt recorded by an operator, put its secret in the environment variable it names, verify it (npm run lamble -- deliver verify <id>; for Telegram also deliver confirm <id> <code>), set enabled to true here and LAMBLE_DELIVERY_ENABLED=true in the job's environment. Verifications are kept in data/delivery/verifications.json. No Telegram bot or webhook destination exists as of 2026-10-20.
